notes.title: Brand new adventure game from the creators of Story of the Olivia [New Game]
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3299940/Omega_Luma__The_First_Battle/

Planet Vega is under fire..

A young man wakes up on a sky island belonging to our world by chance. His name is Lucas.. In this sky island where everything starts over again, we start a journey where we question ourselves, try to survive and meet new people. Our hopes and warrior spirit will accompany us..

Omega Luma comes to Earth from the middle of darkness and aims to destroy the last of all races like the planet Vega.. Lucas must reach the tree of life..

He must collect his memory and destroy the Omega Luma scourge..

But this is not an easy task at all.. We may even lose our closest friends in this cause..

Who knows?

Key Features


 Inventory System
 
 Survival System
 
 Many Side Quests
 
 Fluid Scenario
 
 Crafting System
 
 Equipment
 
 Resource Gathering
 
 Character Traits (Health, Energy...)
 
 Farming (Planting Seeds, Growing Plants/Fruits, Hoeing, Watering)
 
 Farm Animals (Eating, Breeding, Producing)
 
 Wild Animal Behavior (Roaming, Escaping, Chasing)
 
 Hunting and Fishing
 
 Food and Cooking
 
 NPC Shop to Buy/Sell Items
 
 Combat (Attack and HP)
 
 Item Durability and Food Deterioration
 
 Storage Boxes (Chest)
 
 Pets (Chasing, Attacking and Digging Behavior)
 
 Horseback Riding
 
 Save/Load System
 
 Interactive Map


Art


 Animated characters (male and female)
 
 Animated animals (cow, sheep, chicken, pig, deer, bear, squirrel, bird...)
 
 Basic material (wood, grass, rock, straw...)
 
 Gathering tools (hoe, scythe, axe, pickaxe, fishing rod, ...)
 
 Food (fruits, apples, nuts, meat, fish, ...)
 
 Cooked foods (tacos, popcorn, bread...)
 
 Structures (fences, barbecue, safe...)
 
 Environment (trees, bushes, rocks, ground patterns...)
 
 Agricultural products (strawberries, zucchini, peppers, tomatoes, wheat...)

notes.title: All bugs with feedback have been Fixed
notes.content:
Feedback-based bugs have been resolved and game optimization and fluidity have been greatly improved.


Fixed bugs:

If the rescued character mission is activated during hanging, he sits on the ground and we save himself from this hanging.

Greatly fixed enemy weapon grip. Now more accurate and active when aiming at olivia

game brightness increased by one notch

Horse speed and climb have been lowered by one level and adjusted more precisely. Thus, control has been strengthened.

Your feedback is very important to us.
In the games we make, we will fix whatever needs to be fixed according to user comments.

Happy Days
